newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPTIAN POUND UP VS DOLLAR DESPITE DLR SHORTAGE.
newsitem.headline: EGYPTIAN POUND UP VS DOLLAR DESPITE DLR SHORTAGE.

text.p: The Egyptian pound rose slightly against the dollar in the private-sector market on Sunday despite dollar shortage, bankers said.
"Seasonal demand for the dollar by the public sector before the end of the financial year on June 30 created some (dollar) shortage," one banker said.
Another added, "Foreign and local mutual funds are transferring some of their pound assets into dollars because of the stock market weakness".
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3940 to 3.3955 pounds bid and from 3.3959 to 3.3975 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3943 bid and 3.3963 offered. The averages compare with 3.3962 pounds bid and 3.3979 offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390703 buy and 3.397333 sell.
